draft_reason: root-level diagnostics and local development projections were classified after they appeared as open membrane files.
promotion_condition: each diagnostic surface is either migrated to a bounded test/MCP diagnostic, moved to an explicit dev projection, or removed; no unclassified watched root diagnostic remains.
purpose: Classify root-level local diagnostics and development projections so they cannot silently become policy, organs, lifecycle or runtime memory.

local_dev_projection.rule: A local dev projection may support operator development but must not become canonical runtime placement or storage truth.
local_dev_projection.exit_condition: move under an explicit dev projection boundary, generate it from registry policy, or delete it

local_diagnostic.rule: A local diagnostic may probe behavior during cleanup but must not become a hidden test, policy, or lifecycle path.
local_diagnostic.exit_condition: migrate to a bounded test/MCP diagnostic, replace with a Make target, or delete it

quarantined.rule: A quarantined diagnostic is unsafe or obsolete and must not guide active operations.
quarantined.exit_condition: delete, archive as evidence, or replace with a typed diagnostic

transitional.rule: A transitional diagnostic has a known replacement and may exist only during migration.
transitional.exit_condition: complete replacement and remove the root-level diagnostic
